title: Lab - Manage user accounts and groups
description: Create a team of users with the right groups and password policy.
scenario: Create a team of users with the right groups and password policy. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own VM and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# Any Linux VM with sudo will do - Ubuntu 22.04 or Rocky 9, 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM.
# Snapshot it before you start so a broken task is a revert away.
sudo -i
hostnamectl
cleanup: # Revert the VM snapshot, or undo the changes you made by hand.

tasks.title: Task 1 - Users
tasks.instructions: Create users ana, bob and cy with home directories and bash shells; set a password for each.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Group
tasks.instructions: Create group devops and add all three as supplementary members.
tasks.solution:
groupadd devops
usermod -aG devops ana  # etc.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Expiry
tasks.instructions: Force bob to change his password at next login and expire the account on 2030-01-01.
